 Versus
 The State Of Assam
 Rep.

By The Pp, Assam
Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr M Z Shah
Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam
Before Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Susmita Phukan Khaund 20.06.2023
1.

Heard Mr. M.Z. Shah, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Mr. K.K. Das, learned Addl.
P.P. appearing for the State respondent.

2.  The petitioner, namely, Asuruddin Sk, has filed this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C Page No.# 2/2 with prayer for pre-arrest bail as he is apprehending arrest in connection with Chapar P.S.
Case No. 233/2022, under Sections 366/370/376/34 IPC.
3.
I have considered the submissions at the Bar and I have also scrutinized the case diary.
4. The allegation is mainly against the accused no. 1 mentioned in the FIR.
The petitioner is the elder brother of the accused no. 1 mentioned in the FIR.
It is submitted at the Bar that the accused is not involved in connection with the kidnapping or sexual assault of the victim.
Whatever, the allegations, they are directed towards the brother of the present petitioner i.e. Ahirut Zaman.

sentences.text: 5. Considering all aspects, petition is allowed.

6. In the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, under conditions that,
(i) the petitioner will not exercise threats to the witnesses and will not tamper with the evidence, and (ii) the petitioner will appear before the I/O within 7(seven) days and co- operate with the investigation.
